NameError in ReindentFilter when processing CASE statements

#### Description

When formatting SQL with CASE statements using `sqlparse.format()` with `reindent=True`, a NameError occurs because `end_pos` is referenced but not defined.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlparse

# This will raise a NameError
sql = 'case when foo = 1 then 2 when foo = 3 then 4 else 5 end'
formatted = sqlparse.format(sql, reindent=True)
print(formatted)
```

Expected output:
```
case
    when foo = 1 then 2
    when foo = 3 then 4
    else 5
end
```

Actual result: `NameError: name 'end_pos' is not defined`

The same error occurs with other CASE statement variations:
```python
sql2 = 'case(foo) when bar = 1 then 2 else 3 end'
formatted2 = sqlparse.format(sql2, reindent=True)  # Also raises NameError
```
</issue>
